content.en: The **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)** is a first-of-its-kind, whole-of-government exercise to provide world-class infrastructure across the country and improve the quality of life for all citizens. It aims to improve project preparation, attract investments (both domestic and foreign) into infrastructure, and ensure time-bound completion of projects.
content.hi: The **National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP)** is a first-of-its-kind, whole-of-government exercise to provide world-class infrastructure across the country and improve the quality of life for all citizens. It aims to improve project preparation, attract investments (both domestic and foreign) into infrastructure, and ensure time-bound completion of projects.

definition.en: NIP utilizes a digital dashboard to track the progress of projects in real-time to ensure accountability.
definition.hi: NIP utilizes a digital dashboard to track the progress of projects in real-time to ensure accountability.

content.en: NIP relies on a mix of budgetary support, private sector participation, and monetization of assets.
content.hi: NIP relies on a mix of budgetary support, private sector participation, and monetization of assets.

content.en: Do not confuse NIP with the National Monetization Pipeline (NMP); while related, NIP is about building new assets, whereas NMP is about leveraging existing ones.
content.hi: Do not confuse NIP with the National Monetization Pipeline (NMP); while related, NIP is about building new assets, whereas NMP is about leveraging existing ones.

content.en: Focus on how NIP acts as a multiplier for the Indian economy by creating jobs and demand for core industries.
content.hi: Focus on how NIP acts as a multiplier for the Indian economy by creating jobs and demand for core industries.

keyTakeaways.en: NIP is a multi-year infrastructure roadmap.
keyTakeaways.hi: NIP is a multi-year infrastructure roadmap.

keyTakeaways.en: It emphasizes both economic and social infrastructure.
keyTakeaways.hi: It emphasizes both economic and social infrastructure.
